ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT AGREEMENT, made as of this  day of January —,2005(this“Agreement"), between Joma Printing Co. Inc., a New York corporation, having an address at 40 Worth Street, New York, New York 10013 ("Seller") and Bass Associates LLC, a Delaware limited liability company,having an address at 141 Fifth Avenue,PH Floor,New York,New York 10010 ("Developer"). ARTICLE1 RECITALS A.Seller is the owner of certain land known by the street address 521-541 West 25th Street, New York, New York, also known as Tax Lot 13 in Block 697 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York, more particularly described in Schedule A annexed hereto and made a part hereof, together with the improvements thereon (said land being herein referred to as"Seller's Land"). B.The following improvements are currently located on Seller's Land: (i) a one (1) story structure,two (2)story structure and five(5) story structure on the portion of Seller's Land known as 541 West 25th Street (such structures, together with any future replacements thereof in accordance with this Agreement, “Seller's 541 Building"); and (i) a four (4) story structure on the portion of Seller's Land known as 521-539 West 25th Street (such structure, together with any future replacements thereof in accordance with this Agreement, “Seller's 521 Building"). Seller's 541 Building and Seller's 521 Building are collectively referred to herein as “Seller's Existing Building” and Seller's Land and Seller's Existing Building are collectively referred to herein as“Seller's Property." C. Simultaneously with the execution of this Agreement, Whitehall, LLC, an entity owned by the same principals as Seller (*"Fee Seller"), has conveyed to Developer fee simple title to that certain land adjacent to Seller's Land, known.by the street address 543-545 West 25th Street, New York, New York, also known as Tax Lot 10 in Block 697 on the Tax Map of the City of New York,County of New York,more particularly described in Schedule B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein referred to as “Developer's Land").  D. Developer intends to construct a new building or buidings and improvements upon all or a portionof Developer's Land (said newbuilding or buildings and improvements, together with any further replacements thereof or additions thereto, whether upon Developer's Land, being herein referred to as “Developer's Proposed Building"” and Developer's Land and Developer's Proposed Building being herein referred to as “Developer's Property"). E.As used herein, the term “Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoninglot,todevelopsuchzoninglotbyerecting thereona structureor structureswitha total Floor Area (as such term is defined in the Zoning Resolution) determined (i) by multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the maximum allowable Floor Area Ratio (as such term is defined in HFNY2:#786797v.14#04490-005101/18/2005

the Zoning Resolution) for structures in the zoning district or districts in which such zoning lot is located, and (i) any bulk and density rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution and which time to time. F. As used herein, the term “Excess Development Rights" shall mean 41,911 square feet of Floor Area Development Rights that are appurtenant to Seller's Land that are availablefor transfer pursuant to the Zoning Resolution. G.As used herein, the term “Retained Development Rights” shall collectively mean: (i) 81,526 square feet of Floor Area Development Rights pertaining to Seller's Land, and (ii) all Floor Area Development Rights pertaining to Seller's Land created, authorized or arising after the date hereof by any means, including, without limitation, a modification of or amendment to the Zoning Resolution or other change in existing law or an upward revision by theCityofNewYorkoftheallowableFloorAreaRatio. H. As used herein, the term “Total Development Rights" shall collectively mean: (i) the Floor Area Development Rights pertaining to Developer's Land as same exists on the date hereof, (i) the Excess Development Rights, and (ii) all Floor Area Development Rights pertaining to Developer's Land created, authorized or arising after the date hereof by any means, including, without limitation, a modification of or amendment to the Zoning Resolution or other change in existing law or an upward revision by the City of NewYork of the allowable Floor Area Ratio. 1. The parties hereto have been advised that on the date hereof, Seller's Existing Building uses less than the maximum Floor Area Development Rights that are permitted for development on Seller's Land pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, and that, therefore, Seller has available the Excess Development Rights that, under procedures currently available under the Zoning Resolution, may be made available to permit the construction of Developer's Proposed Building with Floor Area greater than that which would be permitted if the Excess Development Rights were not so made available. J. Seller wishes to convey to Developer, and Developer wishes to accept from Seller,the Excess Development Rights in order that Developer's Proposed Building be permitted to have Floor Area greater than that which would be permitted if the Excess Development Rights were not so made available and, in any event, that Developer shall be the owner oftheExcessDevelopmentRights. K.Seller and Developer wish to merge Developer's Property and Seller's Property into a single“zoning lot,”" as such term is defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York,effective December 15,1961 (as amended to date, the “Zoning Resolution") (such single zoning lot being herein referred to as the “Combined Zoning Lot'"). The parties hereto (among others) have executed and delivered a certain Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the“Declaration") dated the date hereof, which is intended to be submitted contemporaneously herewith for recording in the New York County Officeof theRegister of The City of NewYorkwith respect to the Combined Zoning Lot. 2 HFNY2:#786797v.14#04490-005101/18/2005
